turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Take your time.
Callum and I split up in the summer because he said I was obsessed with food.
Take your time.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. That is how it was.
What went through your mind then?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
What went through your mind then?
Bridget suggested a family session, and I might tell my father at Easter.
What went through your mind then?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
What happened next?
I still count calories in my head even when I do not write them down.
What happened next?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. Yes, it was like that.
Take your time.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I restricted again after a bad day when I saw photos of my ex-boyfriend Callum with his new girlfriend.
What happened next?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. That is how it was.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
